Class AuthService

java.lang.Object
AuthService
public class AuthService extends Object
Authentication & account administration backed by the three user CSVs managed by CsvUtil.

Sources:

  • sample_student_list.csv
  • sample_staff_list.csv
  • sample_company_representative_list.csv

Provides:

  • Diagnostic login with explicit failure reasons.
  • Backwards-compatible login (null on failure).
  • Password changes persisted to CSV.
  • Company-rep registration & approval.
  • Lightweight directory lookups used by menus.
Since:
v1.35

    • reload

      public final void reload()
      Reload all three user CSVs into memory.

      On I/O error, logs to System.err and replaces the affected list with an empty one.

    • attemptLogin

      public AuthService.LoginAttempt attemptLogin(String idOrEmail, String password)
      Diagnostic login that explains why a login fails.

      Resolution order: Student â†’ Staff â†’ CompanyRep.

      • On success: success=true and result != null.
      • On failure: success=false, with AuthService.LoginFailureReason set to USER_NOT_FOUND, WRONG_PASSWORD, or NOT_APPROVED (for reps).
      Parameters:
      idOrEmail - student ID / staff ID / email (rep or student)
      password - attempted password
      Returns:
      structured AuthService.LoginAttempt
      Since:
      v1.35

    • login

      public AuthService.AuthResult login(String idOrEmail, String password)
      Backwards-compatible login: returns AuthService.AuthResult on success, null on any failure.

      Internally delegates to attemptLogin(String, String) so there is one source of truth.

      Parameters:
      idOrEmail - student ID / staff ID / email
      password - attempted password
      Returns:
      AuthService.AuthResult on success; null otherwise
      Since:
      v1.35

    • registerCompanyRep

      public boolean registerCompanyRep(String email, String name, String company, String department, String position, String password)
      Register a new company representative.

      On duplicate email, throws with the exact message required by the UI: "Invalid, Company Representative's Email already exist in system."

      Parameters:
      email - login/email (unique key)
      name - display name
      company - company name
      department - department name (optional)
      position - position title (optional)
      password - initial password (defaults to "password" if blank)
      Returns:
      true if written to CSV successfully; false on I/O error
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if a rep with the same email already exists
      IllegalArgumentException - if email is null/blank
      Since:
      v1.35
